title: How to Build Wealth on an Average Salary: The Full Plan
description:
You don't need a big salary to build real wealth. On a typical $60,000 income, saving 15% for 35 years could grow to over $1 million. In this video I look at it from three angles: the numbers (what an average salary can really build), the 6 mindset shifts that matter more than income, and a 12-step plan with a sample $60,000 budget you can copy.

Get The Ryan Rover Money Playbook: [LINK HERE]

- Thomas J. Stanley and William D. Danko, The Millionaire Next Door (1996)
- Growth figures: stated illustrative math at a 7% average yearly return; salary growth illustration at 3% a year
